{"dialogue": "Maya: ugh finally home
Leo: long monday?
Me: how was gym this morning?
Maya: died lol
Maya: leg day should be illegal
Leo: you say that every time
Me: did you go yesterday too or just today?
Maya: just today, i skipped the weekend
Leo: relatable
Leo: my laundry is still in the basket from friday btw
Me: nooo you said you were gonna do it
Leo: i said probably!
Maya: his sink ecosystem now has a laundry counterpart
Me: lol stop
Leo: rude but accurate pt 2
Maya: what did you guys do this weekend?
Me: mostly dishes and that sketch you sent
Leo: oh did you finally watch it??
Me: yeah while doing dishes, the crying suit guy killed me
Maya: never go back to workkkk
Leo: you did the voice perfectly in text somehow
Me: it's stuck in my head now
Maya: same, i was thinking it at the gym
Leo: never go back to leg day
Maya: EXACTLY
Me: did IT ever fix your laptop btw?
Maya: no still slow as hell today
Leo: did you do the off and on again ritual?
Maya: twice today alone
Me: mine was fine today for once
Leo: look at you leaving on time on friday actually worked
Me: i did! 5 sharp like i said
Maya: proud of you, i got stuck till 5:40
Leo: i played that cooking game for like 3 hours friday night
Me: without us??
Leo: randoms, it was chaos, someone burned everything
Maya: sounds like me tbh
Me: you did get better after the third fire
Maya: hey i only started two fires that night
Leo: revisionist history
Maya: whatever, soup and toast night again for me
Me: it's definitely soup weather tonight
Leo: i had leftover pasta again, i'm in a loop
Me: i upgraded from cereal to actual pasta tonight
Maya: growth
Leo: okay so are we still doing lunch this friday?
Maya: yes please, i need something to look forward to
Me: i'm in, what are we thinking?
Leo: pizza? in honor of the crying suit guy
Maya: lol yes, pizza this friday i'm so down
Me: same, pizza sounds perfect
Maya: can we do noon? i have a thing at 1:30
Leo: noon works for me
Me: yeah noon's good for me too
Leo: nice, where tho? not the sandwich place from last week right?
Maya: oh god no, last week took forever
Maya: never again with that line
Me: what about Mario's on Pine Street?
Leo: ohh i haven't been there in ages
Maya: is that the one with the garlic knots?
Me: yes! and they do slices fast so we can make your 1:30
Maya: perfect, yeah that works for me
Leo: yeah that works, i'm in
Me: yay okay
Leo: wait is parking awful over there?
Maya: kinda but i can bus from work
Me: i can walk, it's like 10 mins from my office
Leo: i'll just come early and circle lol
Maya: or we can meet outside at noon?
Me: yeah let's meet out front
Leo: bet
Maya: also are we doing the game again this week?
Leo: i'm down thursday or friday night if you guys are
Me: i might join for one round friday after pizza fuel
Maya: depends how sore i am but maybe
Leo: no pressure, no kitchen fires promised
Maya: no promises from my side
Me: lol
Me: did it get cold again today for you guys?
Maya: freezing this morning again, wore the heavy jacket
Leo: me too, fall jacket season officially
Me: same, i broke mine out last week and now it's daily
Maya: okay i need to make that weird lemon tea again, brb
Leo: save me one virtually
Me: me too, chamomile me up
Maya: okay one weird one for leo, lemon thing for you
Leo: you remembered
Me: alright so friday noon still good?
Maya: yep!
Leo: yep, see you guys there
Maya: can't wait, need pizza after today
Me: same, monday was too long", "writer_note": "Spread the Friday pizza, noon, and Mario's on Pine Street agreements across separate proposals with short acceptances, contrasted with last week's slow sandwich place, while weaving in callbacks to tea, gym, laundry, the sketch slogan, and evening routines to keep it natural."}
